newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint to supply Norway's Hakon.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint to supply Norway's Hakon.

text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc said its Norwegian subsidiary has agreed to become Hakon Group's sole supplier of radio frequency electronic article surveillance systems and implement source tagging throughout its 1,200 supermarkets.
Hakon, withh 250 wholly-owned and 950 franchised stores, controls about 30 percent of Norway's supermarket industry.

"Today's agreement with the Hakon Group strengthens Checkpoint's dominance in both Norway and the entire Nordic market," said Orn Johansson, managing director of Checkpoint Systems Norway. Now, more than 60 percent of the Norwegian supermarket industry has chosen radio frequency as the standard for electronic article surveillance.
In the past year and a half, Checkpoint said, it has installed its anti-theft systems in 24 supermarket chains throughout the world.
